unavailable_or_unclassified: The contact lower bound is operator coercivity,not a scalar mean or one ultrasound reading. Unknown nonlinear background,partial switching,never-switched cracks,finite-body/interaction corrections and local stress-intensity errors are not automatically bounded by small compliance error. No physical measurements,contact coverage,component qualification or practical advantage were acquired.
